name: Five Little Monkeys
description: Five monkeys bounce on one giant bed. Slam the mattress and the ring of quilt launches the others off. Last monkey jumping wins.

controls.action: Slam; throw a pillow when out

badges.name: Double Bounce
badges.description: Knock two monkeys off with one slam.

badges.name: Untouchable
badges.description: Win a round without being launched.

badges.name: Pillow Fight
badges.description: Knock a monkey off with a pillow.

badges.name: Saved It
badges.description: Slam out of a launch and land on the bed.

badges.name: Bunk Boss
badges.description: Win a match on the Bunk Bed.

badges.name: Making Waves
badges.description: Win a match on the Water Bed.

badges.name: Five Beds
badges.description: Win a match on every bed.
